title: Baby busts and GDP booms: Demographic change and the macroeconomy
title_zh: 婴儿潮衰退与GDP繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济
title_primary: 婴儿潮衰退与GDP繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济
title_secondary: Baby busts and GDP booms: Demographic change and the macroeconomy
authors: Daron Acemoglu, David Autor, Keelan Beirne, Andrew Scott
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Globally declining birth rates have, over the last seven decades, slowed population growth and raised average ages. This column argues that despite widespread economic pessimism, historical cross-country and US commuting zone data point to no impact of ageing populations on aggregate GDP or earnings growth. Countries with lower birth rates have higher GDP growth per working-age adult, and US commuting zones with lower birth rates have faster wage growth. The growth-reducing potential of demographic slowdowns is countered by faster technological change. While future demographic changes will occur at greater speed and scale, the economic record suggests that current pessimism is premature.
abstract_zh: 过去七十年间，全球生育率持续下降，导致人口增长放缓、平均年龄上升。本文认为，尽管普遍存在经济悲观情绪，但历史跨国数据与美国通勤区数据表明，人口老龄化对总体GDP或收入增长并无显著影响。生育率较低的国家，其劳动年龄人口的人均GDP增速更高；生育率较低的美国通勤区，工资增长也更快。人口增速放缓对增长的潜在抑制作用，已被更快的技术变革所抵消。尽管未来人口结构变化的速度与规模将更为显著，但经济史实表明，当前的悲观情绪为时过早。

title: Firm Adaptation in Production Networks: Evidence from Extreme Weather Events in Pakistan
title_zh: 生产网络中的企业适应性：来自巴基斯坦极端天气事件的证据
title_primary: 生产网络中的企业适应性：来自巴基斯坦极端天气事件的证据
title_secondary: Firm Adaptation in Production Networks: Evidence from Extreme Weather Events in Pakistan
authors: Balboni, Clare, Boehm, Johannes, Waseem, Mazhar
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper considers how far private adaptation may reduce future vulnerability to climate risks. Using data on monthly firm-to-firm transactions from Pakistan, we find that flood-affected firms are more likely to relocate to safer ground, and shift purchases towards suppliers in less flood-prone regions and reached via less flood-prone roads. The results indicate that firms are imperfectly in- formed about flood risk, and update their beliefs following floods. We quantify aggregate impacts using a spatial model of endogenous production network formation. The findings suggest that firms' learning will shape the economic impact of increasingly frequent climate-related disasters.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨私人适应措施在多大程度上能够降低未来气候风险的脆弱性。利用巴基斯坦企业间月度交易数据，我们发现受洪水影响的企业更倾向于迁往更安全的地带，并将采购转向位于洪水风险较低区域、且通过不易受洪水侵袭道路运输的供应商。研究结果表明，企业对洪水风险的认知并不完全，且会在经历洪水后更新其信念。我们通过构建内生生产网络形成的空间模型来量化总体影响。研究结论表明，企业的学习行为将塑造日益频繁的气候相关灾害对经济的影响。

title: DP749 Regional Versus Multilateral Liberalization of Trade in Services
title_zh: 服务贸易的区域自由化与多边自由化
title_primary: 服务贸易的区域自由化与多边自由化
title_secondary: DP749 Regional Versus Multilateral Liberalization of Trade in Services
authors: Bernard Hoekman, Nan Li, Sergii Meleshchuk, Robert Zymek, Pablo García Guzmán 等
official: 官方在线 1993-02-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper focuses on the relationship between regional agreements and the draft General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), negotiated under the auspices of the Uruguay Round. Following a conceptual discussion of the political economy of regional as opposed to multilateral negotiations, I analyse existing data on trade and investment flows with a view to gaining some insight into the likely interest group preferences influencing the choice between alternative institutional arrangements to liberalize trade in services. Both the data and a comparison of the content of the major existing agreements suggest that service industries are more likely to see regional and multilateral liberalization as complements than substitutes.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于区域协定与乌拉圭回合框架下谈判的《服务贸易总协定》（GATS）草案之间的关系。在从政治经济学角度对区域谈判与多边谈判进行概念性讨论后，我分析了现有的贸易与投资流动数据，以期洞察可能影响不同制度安排选择的利益集团偏好，从而推动服务贸易自由化。数据及对现有主要协定内容的比较均表明，服务业更可能将区域与多边自由化视为互补关系而非替代关系。

title: DP1786 Eastern Enlargement of the EU: How much is it Worth for Austria?
title_zh: 欧盟东扩：对奥地利价值几何？
title_primary: 欧盟东扩：对奥地利价值几何？
title_secondary: DP1786 Eastern Enlargement of the EU: How much is it Worth for Austria?
authors: Wilhelm Kohler, Christian Keuschnigg
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We evaluate potential costs and benefits of Eastern enlargement of the EU. In addressing fiscal costs of enlargement in addition to tariff and non-tariff barriers, we arrive at important conclusions: 1) Overall, extending EU membership to Eastern applicants is more than worth its price to Austria. The (dynamic) gains from integration clearly outweigh the budgetary costs. 2) Somewhat surprisingly, the wage spread between skilled and unskilled labour is narrowed rather than widened. 3) Significant sectoral and intergenerational redistribution may nevertheless render EU enlargement difficult on political grounds, with the agricultural sector and the young losing out.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了欧盟东扩的潜在成本与收益。在考虑关税与非关税壁垒之外，进一步分析扩大的财政成本后，得出以下重要结论：1）总体而言，将欧盟成员资格扩展至东欧申请国对奥地利而言物超所值。一体化带来的（动态）收益明显超过预算成本。2）略令人意外的是，技能型与非技能型劳动力之间的工资差距趋于缩小而非扩大。3）然而，显著的部门间与代际再分配效应可能使欧盟东扩在政治层面面临困难，其中农业部门与年轻群体将成为利益受损方。

title: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
title_zh: 回复《关于加拿大北部营养补贴传导率的评论》
title_primary: 回复《关于加拿大北部营养补贴传导率的评论》
title_secondary: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
authors: Jamie Naylor, B. James Deaton, Alan Ker
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: en In Naylor, Deaton, and Ker (2025), we discuss an appropriate econometric method for estimating the pass-through of the Nutrition North subsidy in the presence of heterogeneous effects and endogenous sampling. Applying this method to the data set compiled by Galloway and Li (2023), who conclude that there is “large leakage” of the subsidy, we fail to find evidence that supports their conclusion. After our paper was published, Galloway and Li published both a corrigendum to their 2023 article and a comment to our paper based on that corrigendum. In their comment, Galloway and Li (2026) claim that after “minor but easily justified” changes to their original data, our econometric approach leads to either imprecise or incomplete estimates of pass-through. In our response we show that: (i) Galloway and Li (2026) choose a classification of market structure that differs from the one recommended by federal government officials and from the classification they themselves use in their most recent work, including Galloway and Li (2025b) and Li, Daley, and Watson (2025); (ii) the classification structure consistent with the recommendations of federal government officials and their aforementioned research supports full pass-through; (iii) Galloway and Li's (2026) removal of 75% of the original sample is not minor; and (iv) Galloway and Li's (2026) repeated emphasis on sub-sampling, robustness, and statistical power is incomplete and thus misleading. Importantly, our response emphasizes that the correct econometric approach does not turn on whether one can selectively find a data set in which the empirical estimate of pass-through changes.
abstract_zh: 在Naylor、Deaton与Ker（2025）的研究中，我们探讨了在存在异质性效应与内生抽样条件下，估算“营养北方”补贴传导效应的适当计量方法。将该方法应用于Galloway与Li（2023）编制的数据集（该研究得出补贴存在“大量渗漏”的结论）后，我们未能发现支持其结论的证据。论文发表后，Galloway与Li针对其2023年文章发布了勘误，并基于该勘误对我们的论文发表了评论。在评论中，Galloway与Li（2026）声称，对其原始数据进行“微小但易于论证”的调整后，我们的计量方法对传导效应的估算要么不精确，要么不完整。我们的回应表明：（i）Galloway与Li（2026）选择的市场结构分类，既不同于联邦政府官员推荐的分类标准，也不同于其自身最新研究（包括Galloway与Li（2025b）及Li、Daley与Watson（2025））所使用的分类；（ii）与联邦政府官员建议及上述研究一致的分类结构支持完全传导效应；（iii）Galloway与Li（2026）剔除75%原始样本的做法并非“微小调整”；（iv）Galloway与Li（2026）反复强调子样本分析、稳健性与统计功效的做法不完整且具有误导性。重要的是，我们的回应强调：正确的计量方法并不取决于能否选择性找到传导效应实证估计值发生变化的数据集。

title: Women Prefer Larger Governments: Growth, Structural Transformation and Government Size
title_zh: 女性偏好更大规模的政府：增长、结构转型与政府规模
title_primary: 女性偏好更大规模的政府：增长、结构转型与政府规模
title_secondary: Women Prefer Larger Governments: Growth, Structural Transformation and Government Size
authors: José Tavares, Tiago Cavalcanti
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The increase in income per capita is accompanied, in virtually all countries, by two changes in the structure of the economy, namely an increase in the share of government spending in GDP and an increase in female labour force participation. This paper suggests that these two changes are causally related. We develop a growth model where the structure of the economy is endogenous so that participation in market activities and government size are causally related. Economic growth and rising incomes are accompanied by a greater incentive for women to engage in labour market activities as the opportunity cost of staying at home increases. We hypothesize that government spending decreases the cost of performing household chores such as, but not limited to, child rearing and child care so that couples decide to engage further in the labour market and chose a higher tax rate to finance more government spending. Using a wide cross-section of data for developed and developing countries, we show that higher participation by women in the labour market are indeed positively associated with larger governments. Furthermore, we investigate the causal link between the two variables using as instrumental variables a unique and novel dataset on the relative price of home appliances across OECD countries and over time. We find strong evidence of a causal link between participation in the labour market and government size: a 10 percent rise in participation in the labour market leads to a 7 to 8 percent rise in government size. This effect is robust to the country sample, time period, and a set of controls in the spirit of Rodrik (1998). The inclusion of an endogenous choice of government spending allows a considerable extension of the model in Galor and Weil (2000) so fertility can either rise or fall and phenomena like the baby boom and baby bust in Greenwood at el. (2002) can be addressed. In addition, the paper has important implications for the analysis of the secular as well as cross-country determinants of government size.
abstract_zh: 几乎所有国家的人均收入增长都伴随着经济结构的两种变化，即政府支出占GDP比重的上升和女性劳动参与率的提高。本文提出这两种变化存在因果关系。我们构建了一个经济结构内生的增长模型，使市场活动参与度与政府规模形成因果关联。随着经济增长和收入提高，女性因居家机会成本上升而更倾向于参与劳动力市场活动。我们假设政府支出降低了育儿等家务劳动成本，促使家庭选择更高税率以支持更多政府支出，从而进一步参与劳动力市场。基于发达国家与发展中国家的跨国截面数据，我们发现女性劳动参与率提高确实与政府规模扩大呈正相关。进一步地，我们利用OECD国家跨时期家电相对价格这一独特新颖数据集作为工具变量，探究两变量间的因果联系。研究证实劳动参与率与政府规模存在显著因果关系：劳动参与率每提升10%，政府规模将扩大7%-8%。该效应在罗德里克（1998）框架下对样本国家、时间跨度及控制变量组合均保持稳健。通过引入政府支出的内生选择，本文对Galor和Weil（2000）模型进行了重要拓展，使生育率既可上升也可下降，并能解释Greenwood等（2002）提出的婴儿潮与婴儿低谷现象。此外，本研究对分析政府规模的长期趋势及跨国决定因素具有重要启示。

title: Migration opportunities and human capital investments
title_zh: 迁移机会与人力资本投资
title_primary: 迁移机会与人力资本投资
title_secondary: Migration opportunities and human capital investments
authors: Esther Gehrke
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how shocks to migration opportunities affect schooling outcomes in origin communities. We focus on the migration between Mexico and the United States, and exploit the expansion of the Secure Communities program in the US—a federal data-sharing program that substantially increased the risk of deportation for illegal migrants—as an exogenous shock to the attractiveness of illegal migration. Our results suggest that the Secure Communities program increased attendance, enrollment, and educational attainment in municipalities that had stronger migration-network links with counties in the US that adopted the program early-on relative to municipalities that had ties with US counties that introduced the policy somewhat later. These results are consistent with the interpretation that the Secure Communities program raised the returns to education for prospective migrants by making low-skill migration to the US less attractive.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了移民机会的冲击如何影响原籍社区的教育成果。本文聚焦于墨西哥与美国之间的移民流动，并利用美国“安全社区”计划的扩展——一项大幅增加非法移民遣返风险的联邦数据共享计划——作为非法移民吸引力的外生冲击。研究结果表明，相较于那些与美国较晚实施该政策的县有移民网络联系的市镇，与美国早期实施该政策的县有更强移民网络联系的市镇，其出勤率、入学率和教育成就均有所提高。这些结果与以下解释一致：“安全社区”计划通过降低低技能移民赴美的吸引力，提高了潜在移民的教育回报率。

title: Place-based industrial policies in the long run
title_zh: 长期视角下的地方产业政策
title_primary: 长期视角下的地方产业政策
title_secondary: Place-based industrial policies in the long run
authors: Stephan Heblich, Marlon Seror, Yanos Zylberberg
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: There is growing evidence that place-based industrial policies lead to positive economic effects. This column analyses the “Million-Rouble Plants” programme of the 1950s when the Soviet Union helped China build state-of-the-art industrial facilities. By tracking the locations that benefitted, it finds positive economic spillovers in the short and medium run. Although the Million-Rouble Plants themselves continued to thrive, the performance of other local establishments eventually declined, as increasing specialisation weakened knowledge spillovers and constrained local entrepreneurship. Policymakers may achieve more durable gains by fostering diversified local production structures that encourage knowledge spillovers, labour market resilience, and adaptation to technological and market shocks.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，地方性产业政策能够带来积极的经济效应。本文分析了20世纪50年代苏联帮助中国建设先进工业设施的“百万卢布工厂”计划。通过追踪受益地区，研究发现该计划在短期和中期内产生了正向经济溢出效应。尽管“百万卢布工厂”本身持续繁荣，但其他本地企业的绩效最终出现下滑，原因在于日益增强的专业化削弱了知识溢出效应，并限制了本地创业活力。政策制定者若想实现更持久的收益，应培育多元化的地方生产结构，以促进知识溢出、增强劳动力市场韧性，并提升应对技术与市场冲击的适应能力。

title: Higher utilisation explains the recent surge in productivity growth
title_zh: 更高的利用率解释了近期生产率增长的激增
title_primary: 更高的利用率解释了近期生产率增长的激增
title_secondary: Higher utilisation explains the recent surge in productivity growth
authors: Shane Boyle, John Fernald, Huiyu Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: US labour productivity has accelerated since 2022. Output per hour grew around 2.5% per year from the end of 2022 to the start of 2026, exceeding its pre-pandemic pace by 1 percentage point. A natural conjecture is that artificial intelligence has raised production efficiency. This column argues that the data suggest otherwise. Higher utilisation – that is, more intense use of labour and capital already in place – accounts for much of the recent acceleration. AI may have contributed to the higher utilisation rate, but through strong demand and heightened uncertainty rather than through efficiency.
abstract_zh: 自2022年以来，美国劳动生产率加速增长。从2022年底到2026年初，每小时产出年均增长约2.5%，较疫情前增速高出1个百分点。一个自然的猜想是人工智能提升了生产效率。但本专栏认为，数据表明情况并非如此。更高的利用率——即对现有劳动力和资本的更密集使用——是近期生产率加速的主要原因。人工智能可能对利用率提升有所贡献，但这是通过强劲需求和不确定性加剧实现的，而非通过效率提升。

title: Strapped for Cash: The Role of Financial Constraints for Innovating Firms, Misallocation and Aggregate Productivity Growth
title_zh: 资金紧张：金融约束对创新企业、资源错配及全要素生产率增长的作用

title_secondary: Strapped for Cash: The Role of Financial Constraints for Innovating Firms, Misallocation and Aggregate Productivity Growth
authors: Bøler, Esther Ann, Moxnes, Andreas, Ulltveit-Moe, Karen Helene
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze the impact of reduced financial constraints on innovating firms' performance and access to credit using a reform that allowed firms to use patents as collateral. We develop a theoretical framework to guide the analysis and quantify the aggregate impact of reduced financial constraints on misallocation and productivity by mapping data moments, reduced form results and model counterparts. Our empirical results suggest that reduced financial constraints led to an increase in firms' capital stock and bank debt. Parameterizing the model we find quantitatively large gains in output per worker in the sectors of the economy dominated by constrained firms.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项允许企业以专利作为抵押品的改革，分析了金融约束缓解对创新企业绩效和信贷获取的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架来指导分析，并通过匹配数据矩、简化形式结果与模型对应项，量化了金融约束缓解对资源错配和生产率的总体影响。实证结果表明，金融约束缓解导致企业资本存量和银行债务增加。通过参数化模型，我们发现，在受约束企业主导的经济部门中，人均产出实现了显著的量化增长。

title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性
title_primary: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性
title_secondary: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
authors: Barry Eichengreen
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政政策反应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释，该框架认为债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。

title: Prime vs. Subprime: Asymmetric Information and Equilibrium Securitization in a Business Cycle Model
title_zh: 优质与次级：商业周期模型中的信息不对称与均衡证券化
title_primary: 优质与次级：商业周期模型中的信息不对称与均衡证券化
title_secondary: Prime vs. Subprime: Asymmetric Information and Equilibrium Securitization in a Business Cycle Model
authors: Federico Ravenna
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where loan securitization is an endogenous outcome in a credit market where information asymmetries lead to adverse selection across financial intermediaries. Securitization occurs when the resources saved by investors acquiring limited information about the risk-class of some borrowers outweigh the cost of being selected against by loan originators. This results in a time-varying market share of individually risk-priced loans held by banks, and of securitized loans held by the secondary market. We analyze the impact of conventional monetary policies and credit market policies in response to an increase in default risk, and discuss its welfare implications. Overall securitization allows more efficient funding of loans, at the expense of increased volatility in risky interest rates, consumption, and inflation over the business cycle.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中贷款证券化是信贷市场中信息不对称导致金融中介机构之间逆向选择的内生结果。当投资者获取部分借款人风险等级信息所节省的资源超过其被贷款发起人逆向选择所付出的成本时，证券化便会产生。这导致银行持有的个别风险定价贷款与二级市场持有的证券化贷款的市场份额随时间动态变化。我们分析了常规货币政策与信贷市场政策在应对违约风险上升时的效果，并探讨其福利影响。总体而言，证券化能够更高效地为贷款提供资金，但代价是加剧了经济周期中风险利率、消费和通胀的波动性。

title: Which Reference Groups Matter and How? A Relative Income Information Experiment with Administrative Data
title_zh: 哪些参照群体重要以及如何重要？基于行政数据的相对收入信息实验

title_secondary: Which Reference Groups Matter and How? A Relative Income Information Experiment with Administrative Data
authors: Xiaogeng Xu, Satu Metsälampi, Michael Kirchler, Kaisa Kotakorpi, Peter Hans Matthews 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Received wisdom holds that income rank matters for life satisfaction, but causal evidence on the nature and impact of income comparisons is limited. We randomize individuals from a representative sample of mid-career Finns to receive personal rank information from one of several reference groups. We find strong evidence of the effect of rank information on income satisfaction, but weaker effects on life satisfaction, and some evidence of real effects in experimental and administrative data. Effects are strong in narrow reference groups and weak and insignificant in the national one. Finally, we discuss the implications for income transparency policies. (JEL D31, D63, D83, D91, I31)
abstract_zh: 普遍观点认为，收入排名对生活满意度至关重要，但关于收入比较的性质及其影响的因果证据仍然有限。我们随机选取芬兰职业生涯中期人群的代表性样本，向其提供来自多个参照组之一的个人排名信息。研究发现，排名信息对收入满意度具有显著影响，但对生活满意度的影响较弱；实验数据与行政数据均显示存在部分实际效应。该效应在狭窄参照组中表现强烈，而在全国性参照组中则微弱且不显著。最后，我们探讨了该发现对收入透明度政策的启示。（JEL分类号：D31, D63, D83, D91, I31）

title: School Choice and the Housing Market
title_zh: 择校与住房市场

title_secondary: School Choice and the Housing Market
authors: Aram Grigoryan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighborhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighborhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighborhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighborhood priorities than without them.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我构建了一个包含学校与居住选择的统一理论框架，用以研究公立学校从传统学区分配转向延迟接受机制所产生的福利影响。研究发现，当家庭在学区学校获得更高优先级时，延迟接受机制相较于学区分配能带来更高的总体或功利主义福利。在共同学校排名假设下，我还证明，相较于无学区优先级的情形，带有学区优先级的延迟接受机制能创造更高的总体福利。

title: Extreme Weather Events and Consumer Food Responses
title_zh: 极端天气事件与消费者食品反应
title_primary: 极端天气事件与消费者食品反应
title_secondary: Extreme Weather Events and Consumer Food Responses
authors: Ahmad Zia Wahdat, Joseph Balagtas
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates consumer food responses to Hurricanes Helene and Milton, which affected a swath of the Southeastern U.S. in 2024. Using representative consumer survey data from six affected states, we analyze 10 distinct food responses classified into ex ante and ex post responses, and examine their associations with food insufficiency and diet quality. We find that ex ante food stockpiling is associated with a lower likelihood of food insufficiency and a higher diet quality score. Conversely, the ex post drop in food spending due to income loss is associated with a higher likelihood of food insufficiency and a lower diet quality score. We also examine heterogeneity in food responses across sociodemographic groups. Our results suggest that targeted support for families with children and low‐income households warrant consideration.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2024年影响美国东南部地区的飓风海伦和米尔顿对消费者食品应对行为的影响。基于来自六个受灾州的代表性消费者调查数据，我们将10种不同的食品应对行为分为事前应对和事后应对两类，并分析了它们与食品不足和膳食质量之间的关联。研究发现，事前囤积食品与较低的食品不足发生率和较高的膳食质量评分相关。相反，因收入损失导致的事后食品支出下降则与较高的食品不足发生率和较低的膳食质量评分相关。我们还考察了不同社会人口群体在食品应对行为上的异质性。研究结果表明，针对有子女家庭和低收入家庭的有针对性支持值得考虑。

title: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions
title_zh: 集体道德风险、风险分担与银行业联盟
title_primary: 集体道德风险、风险分担与银行业联盟
title_secondary: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions
authors: Anatoli Segura, Sergio Vicente
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyze optimal cross-country risk sharing and bank capital requirements amid collective moral hazard by governments and banks. Transfers provide insurance but weaken fiscal discipline. Since lenient fiscal policies amplify banks’ risk-shifting, optimal support must be contingent on banking system health. For fiscally weak countries, support is larger in sovereign crises with solvent banks. For fiscally strong countries, support is larger in joint sovereign and bank crises, requiring deposit insurance mutualization. Optimal contracts feature lower capital requirements than without cross-country transfers, raising the cost of joint sovereign and bank crises to strengthen fiscal discipline and enable greater risk sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在政府与银行集体道德风险背景下，跨国风险分担与银行资本要求的最优设计。转移支付虽能提供保险，但会削弱财政纪律。由于宽松的财政政策会加剧银行的风险转移行为，最优支持必须取决于银行体系的健康状况。对于财政薄弱的国家，在主权危机中若银行具备偿付能力，支持力度更大；对于财政强劲的国家，在主权与银行双重危机中支持力度更大，这要求存款保险实现共同化。与无跨国转移支付的情形相比，最优合约设定的资本要求更低，这通过提高主权与银行双重危机的成本来强化财政纪律，并促进更大程度的风险分担。

title: The impacts of illegal logging acts on China’s wood products exports: univariate and cointegration intervention analyses
title_zh: 非法采伐行为对中国木制品出口的影响：单变量与协整干预分析
title_primary: 非法采伐行为对中国木制品出口的影响：单变量与协整干预分析
title_secondary: The impacts of illegal logging acts on China’s wood products exports: univariate and cointegration intervention analyses
authors: Miaoying Shi, Xing Sun, Li Meng
official: 官方在线 2025-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Illegal logging and associated trade in illegally sourced wood products are major problems and global issues for forest deforestation, environmental damage, and sustainable development. This paper applies univariate and cointegration intervention analyses to investigate the impacts of three illegal logging acts enacted by United States, European Union, and Australia on China’s exports, the largest manufacturer and exporter of wood-based panel products worldwide. We find that China’s export quantity effects of all three acts are negative. Similarly large changes in wood-based panel export quantities to United States and European Union have occurred, while smaller, and statistically insignificant by using the univariate approach, changes have been found for particle board and plywood to Australia. Particle board’s export quantity effects are generally larger in magnitude in percentage change than fibreboard and plywood. KEYWORDS: International trade illegal logging acts wood products exports intervention analyses JEL CLASSIFICATION: F13 F14 C22 L73 O53 Acknowledgements We gratefully acknowledge financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 71703093), Shanghai Philosophy and Social Sciences Planning Program (Program No. 2023BGL004), and Shanghai Pujiang Program (Program No. 15PJC044).
abstract_zh: 非法采伐及与之相关的非法来源木材产品贸易是导致森林砍伐、环境破坏和阻碍可持续发展的重大全球性问题。本文运用单变量和协整干预分析，研究美国、欧盟和澳大利亚颁布的三项非法采伐法案对全球最大人造板产品制造和出口国——中国出口的影响。研究发现，三项法案均对中国出口量产生负面效应。其中，中国对美国、欧盟的人造板出口量变化幅度较大且显著，而对澳大利亚的刨花板和胶合板出口量变化幅度较小，且单变量分析显示统计不显著。从百分比变化幅度看，刨花板的出口量效应普遍大于纤维板和胶合板。关键词：国际贸易；非法采伐法案；木材产品出口；干预分析 JEL分类号：F13 F14 C22 L73 O53 致谢：本研究获国家自然科学基金（项目编号：71703093）、上海市哲学社会科学规划课题（项目编号：2023BGL004）及上海市浦江人才计划（项目编号：15PJC044）资助。
